title: Marketing Assistant/Analyst I
description:
- Marketing Assistant/Analyst I (UK) (Internal role specification: Marketing Operations Associate)
- Location: Northwich, United Kingdom
- Duration: 1 year contract with potential for extension
- Pay Rate: £16.00 / hour (GBP)

Core Responsibilities
- EPIC / EBS Process Ownership: Drive and manage end-to-end system operations for creating, adjusting, and maintaining part numbers and records in internal systems (EPIC and EBS). Ensure data accuracy, complete information submissions, track approvals, and resolve system workflow bottlenecks.
- Product Management Support: Provide operational support to the Product Management team by tracking agreed actions, following up on cross-functional deliverables, maintaining documentation, and ensuring project timelines are met.

Key Qualifications & Requirements
- System & Process Proficiency: Hands-on experience navigating business systems and structured approval processes (e.g., ERP platforms like SAP).
- Workflow Coordination: Proven ability to manage multi-step, detailed processes across different systems and cross-functional teams with high accuracy and follow-through.
- Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to track down inputs, chase actions diplomatically, and maintain status updates across teams.
- Detail-Oriented & Dependable: High attention to detail regarding data entries/part numbers with a proactive approach to routine, business-critical change control tasks.
- Preferred Experience: Prior background in supply chain, operations, change control, or product management workflows (especially part setup and system maintenance) is highly advantageous.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Executive (Temporary Contract)

Location: Chester
Salary: Up to £20.51 per hour
Contract: Temporary, minimum 3-month assignment
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm
Start Date: ASAP

About the Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic and creative Marketing Executive to join a well-established and highly tenured team on a temporary basis for a minimum of three months. This role has arisen to provide cover for a team member who is currently absent, offering an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact within a busy marketing function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who can hit the ground running, bring fresh ideas, and help deliver engaging marketing campaigns across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and create engaging content across social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn
- Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Work closely with the company's videographer to develop creative content
- Create new marketing content to enhance brand engagement and visibility
- Update and maintain website content
- Support SEO initiatives to improve online performance and search rankings
- Monitor social media activity and identify opportunities to increase engagement
- Assist with wider marketing projects as required

About You

The successful candidate will:
- Have previous experience within a marketing role
- Be confident creating content for social media platforms
- Have experience managing LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram business accounts
- Possess strong written communication and content creation skills
- Have knowledge of website management and SEO best practices
- Be proactive, creative, and able to work independently
- Be able to quickly integrate into an established team and make a positive contribution from day one

What's in it for You?
- Competitive pay of up to £20.51 per hour
- Opportunity to join a supportive and experienced team
- Varied and creative workload
- Immediate start available
- Chance to make a real impact during a key period for the business

title: Senior Ecommerce Executive
description:
New Opportunity - Senior Ecommerce Executive

Chester - Salary 40k - Hybrid Working

Are you an experienced eCommerce professional with strong people management skills? We're looking for an ambitious Senior Ecommerce Executive to support the daily operations of a busy eCommerce department, helping to drive online performance, customer engagement and commercial success.

This role focuses on managing product listings, executing promotional activities and maintaining the online storefront. You will play a pivotal role in implementing the online strategy and ensuring smooth operational flow across the consumer business.

Responsibilities:

Product Management

Assist in managing the product lifecycle, including updating product listings and working with product ranging and supply chain teams to help manage product inventory.

Campaign Execution

Work closely with the online team to coordinate and execute online campaigns. Use key trends, events and competitor analysis to forward plan deals, promotions and areas of focus. Be aware of external factors that may affect trading behaviour and act accordingly to trade the chamber.

Content & Merchandising Updates

Update website content as needed, including banner uploads, product descriptions and other site updates to ensure content remains fresh, accurate and engaging.

Data Analysis

Assist in analysing sales data and customer behaviour to identify trends, performance metrics and areas for improvement.

Support Online Strategy

Collaborate with other team members on cross-functional projects and initiatives designed to drive online growth and customer engagement.

Sales & Performance Monitoring

Track and analyse sales performance across Chamber-specific categories, using data-driven insights to make informed decisions on stock levels.

Collaboration with Buying Department

Ensure there is a seamless flow of information and alignment on product selection, availability and pricing.

Channel Optimisation

Work closely with the marketing teams to ensure category traffic is optimised across all ecommerce channels, including email, social and affiliates. Nominate products for email selection based on seasonality, performance and sales opportunities.

Alignment with Online IT

Collaborate with the development team to identify opportunities and resolve issues relating to website functionality and supporting systems.

Skills Required:
- Must have previous experience working in a similar Ecommerce/Digital role, preferably within an ecommerce, retail, or consumer sector
- Proven people management experience
- Strong analytical and commercial skills
- Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments
- Organised, proactive and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

If you're passionate about ecommerce, data-driven decision making and delivering exceptional online experiences, we'd love to hear from you!
